classic.label: With rounds
classic.description: Round by round: whoever is done waits for the others before the next round begins.

queue.label: With tables and a queue
queue.description: The schedule is fixed from the start. As soon as a table is free the next match starts, so nobody waits for a whole round.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Everybody plays everybody else exactly once. The schedule is fixed from the start. Good up to about 8 players.

champions_league.label: Champions League
champions_league.description: Everybody gets the same number of drawn opponents, but not all of them. The schedule is fixed from the start. Good for about 9 to 24 players.

swiss.label: Swiss system
swiss.description: Opponents are paired round by round by the standings, nobody meets anybody twice. Good for large fields.

setup.title: Settings
setup.editHint: You can change this until the tournament starts. The schedule is drawn at the start.
setup.roundsHint: An even number, at most the number of players minus 1. A match is an encounter of two players without a draw; with best of 3 it consists of several games.
setup.roundsRoundRobin: In a round robin the number follows from the number of players: everybody plays everybody once.
setup.prelaunch: Head start: draw rounds 1 and 2 in advance
setup.prelaunchHint: The first two rounds are fixed at the start, every further one is paired as soon as the one before the last is done.
setup.estimateNeedsPlayers: The duration can be estimated as soon as at least two players are registered.
setup.perPlayer: {count} matches per player, {total} matches in all
setup.compare: Duration of the modes with {count} players
setup.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
setup.formatHint: What the players' decks are checked against. You can change it until the tournament starts.

board.tableHelp: Sorted by points. Ties are broken first by the direct comparison (who won the match against the player level on points), then by the difference between games won and lost, then by the games won. Whoever left is grey and at the end without a place.

columns.gamesHelp: Games won : lost (a single game counts as 1:0)
columns.diffHelp: Games won minus games lost. With equal points and an equal direct comparison the better difference decides, then the games won.
columns.matchdaysHelp: Matchdays the player has already played on

board.tablesHelp: As soon as a table is free the next match starts by itself. Players with the most open matches go first, at a tie whoever has waited longest.
board.scheduleHelp: The schedule is fixed from the start. Matchdays are only a display: a match is played as soon as a table and both players are free.
board.scheduleHelpSwiss: In the Swiss system each round is paired as soon as the one before it is done. Later rounds only show up then.
board.resultFailed: The result could not be saved.
board.scheduleHelpRounds: All matches of a matchday are played side by side. The next matchday starts as soon as the last match of the current one is done.
board.pinTableHelp: The table stays at the top when you scroll.
board.unpinTableHelp: The table scrolls with the page and shows every player at once.
board.tableScrolls: The table scrolls: more players are above or below. With “Release table” you see everybody at once.

rematch.title: Rematch needed
rematch.text: {a} and {b} have already played each other, but there is no other opponent to make up the match. Schedule it anyway?
rematch.failed: The match could not be scheduled.

decider.title: Tie for first place
decider.text: {names} are level. A deciding match settles first place.
decider.failed: The deciding match could not be scheduled.

recompute.hint: Only pairings that have not started are drawn again from the current standings. Played and running matches stay.
recompute.noChange: Nothing would change at the current standings.
recompute.failed: The pairings could not be recalculated.

undecided.title: Decision pending
undecided.text: {names} left. The open matches wait until you have decided.

leave.title: {name} leaves
leave.intro: What should happen to the matches of {name}? In the standings {name} stays grey and without a place and still sees their own result.

optionA.label: A · As if they had never been there
optionA.description: All matches are struck, the played ones too. Whoever played or was to play them gets a replacement match.

optionB.label: B · Played matches stay
optionB.description: Only the open matches are struck. Whoever still had an open match against them gets a replacement match.

leave.unavailable: This does not add up at the current standing: afterwards not everybody would have the same number of matches.
leave.laterHint: Their matches wait until you have decided.
leave.inDuel: The player is in a match right now. Enter the result first.

disqualify.title: Disqualify {name}?
disqualify.description: {name} disappears from the standings completely and all matches are struck, as if they had never been there. This cannot be undone.
disqualify.failed: The disqualification could not be saved.

finish.title: Save and end the tournament?
finish.description: Everything that was played stays as the result. Matches that are still open will not be played.

help.title: How it works
help.point1: A match is an encounter of two players, with best of 3 up to three games. There is no draw and no time limit – only the winner is entered.
help.point2: All players end with the same number of matches. The tournament runs until everybody has played theirs.
help.point3: As soon as a table is free, the next possible match starts. Whoever sits at a table shows under “Now”; whoever waits sees their number in the queue.
help.point4: If somebody drops out, the app rearranges the matches so everybody has the same number again.
help.rounds1: It is played matchday by matchday: all matches of a day run side by side, the next day starts when the last one is done.

queue.label: With tables and a queue
queue.description: The plan is fixed from the start. As soon as a table is free, the next match starts – nobody waits for a whole round.

rounds.label: In rounds (matchdays)
rounds.description: Matchday by matchday: all matches of a day are played side by side, the next day starts when the last match is done. No tables, no queue.

classic.label: Classic (rounds with points)
classic.description: Round by round with points: whoever is done waits for the others before the next round starts. The older kind of tournament, with scoring and byes.

1.label: A single match (one game)
1.description: One game decides; only the winner is entered.

3.label: Best of 3
3.description: The first to win two games. You enter the result as 2:0 or 2:1; the minutes per match are for all games together.

queue.scoringSingleHint: With single games a win is 3 points and a loss 0. Scoring by games (3 · 2 · 1 · 0) only exists for best of 3.

extend.label: Play another matchday
extend.title: Play another matchday?
extend.description: A new matchday is drawn: players level on points meet, and nobody plays someone they already played unless there is no other way (after a round robin the new day is a return leg). The tournament keeps running until you save and end it.
extend.failed: The matchday could not be added.

swiss.label: Swiss
swiss.description: Players with similar records play each other; rematches are avoided.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Every player plays every other player exactly once.

games.label: By games (3 · 2 · 1 · 0)
games.description: A win without dropping a game is worth 3 points, a win that dropped a game 2, a loss that won a game 1, any other loss 0. A 2:0 therefore ranks above a 2:1.

match.label: Classic (3 · 0)
match.description: A win is 3 points, a loss 0, whatever the games. (A draw is 1, only in older tournaments.)

none.label: No points
none.description: A player who sits out gets no points and no match played.

win.label: Like a 2:0 win
win.description: A player who sits out gets 3 points, as after a 2:0 win.

scoringPanel.title: Scoring
